comment: Slices of the .NET libraries' tests on WitOS (plan step R7.3), which @Docs/Implementation/R7.3-Library-Tests.md explains. projects: upstream's library test projects runtime-witos builds for witos and the guest runs under xunit's console runner, a process a project, without the categories upstream's CI leaves out. excluded: test methods (xunit's -nomethod names or patterns) the guest leaves out, each with the reason; an entry whose value is an object names in architectures the ISAs it applies to (V2.4). Every other test must pass.

builds a BigInteger of 2^31 bits twice, 256 MB each, past the pages a process commits (the system layer's quota, 256 MiB)

System.Numerics.Tests.BigIntegerTests_Ge.reason: a bug of the community RISC-V JIT, not of WitOS: with dynamic PGO and on-stack replacement, a BigInteger passed in registers to a method it does not inline arrives with its int field not sign-extended, and the checked narrowing of BigInteger's explicit conversion to sbyte then throws OverflowException for a negative value; reproduced under corerun on riscv64 (no failure with TieredPGO, tiered compilation or QuickJitForLoops off, none on arm64), an open question of the V2.4 document to report upstream
